categories.name: parrot-drone
categories.description: Parrot minidrone communication and accessory control

customDescriptions.value: Fire the cannon accessory on a Parrot minidrone — use for triggering the ball launcher in drone competition or gamification scenarios
Control the grabber accessory on a Parrot minidrone — use for picking up and releasing objects in autonomous retrieval missions
Read keyboard input during simulation — use for manual pilot control or interactive testing of drone flight algorithms
Convert raw camera images from Parrot drone format — use for preprocessing onboard camera data before computer vision algorithms
Receive data over TCP/IP from a Parrot drone — use for receiving telemetry, status, or sensor data from the drone during flight
Send data over TCP/IP to a Parrot drone — use for transmitting commands or configuration to the drone during operation
Receive data over UDP from a Parrot drone — use for low-latency reception of video, sensor, or navigation data from the drone
Send data over UDP to a Parrot drone — use for low-latency command transmission to the drone flight controller
